info.title: InvestiTrack Project Execution
info.description: Project workflows, membership, weighted progress, evidence links, final reports and publications. Lists return items/page with limit,nextCursor,hasMore. Mutable resources return ETag; public resource bodies use camelCase PostgreSQL model fields, with coordinatorId on projects.
